title: Site-wide — Content

fields.message: Site-wide — site chrome, shown on every page. These are read directly by the plugin rather than filling a section's {{slots}}. A shortcode attribute still wins over anything saved here, for that one placement.

fields.label: Logo
fields.name: brg_header_logo
fields.instructions: The mark in the bar. An SVG stays crisp at any size.

fields.label: Logo height
fields.name: brg_header_logo_height
fields.instructions: How tall it is in the bar, in pixels. The bar sizes itself from its contents, so a taller logo makes a taller bar — and it still scales down when the page scrolls.

fields.label: Brand name (read aloud by screen readers)
fields.name: brg_header_brand_name
fields.instructions: What someone using a screen reader hears in place of the logo image.

fields.label: Logo links to
fields.name: brg_header_logo_href
fields.instructions: Where clicking the logo goes. Worth checking if a temporary landing page is ever sitting at the root.

fields.label: Layout
fields.name: brg_header_layout
fields.instructions: Where the logo sits and how the links arrange around it.

fields.label: Link text size
fields.name: brg_header_link_size
fields.instructions: The size of the words in the bar, in pixels.

fields.label: Space between links
fields.name: brg_header_link_gap
fields.instructions: The gap from one link to the next. Tighten this before reducing the size when a long menu is close to wrapping.

fields.label: Links before the logo
fields.name: brg_header_left
fields.instructions: Only used by the layouts that put links either side of a centered logo.

fields.label: Links after the logo
fields.name: brg_header_right
fields.instructions: As above, for the other side. On a logo-left layout this is the only one that counts.

fields.label: “More” button text
fields.name: brg_header_more_label
fields.instructions: The wording on the button that opens the overflow panel.

fields.label: Links on the bar before “More”
fields.name: brg_header_bar_max
fields.instructions: 0 means show every link and never overflow. Any other number caps the bar and moves the rest into the panel.

fields.label: Pages
fields.name: brg_header_pin_pages
fields.instructions: Whether the page links sit in the top group, which scrolls if it is long, or the bottom group pinned to the foot of the screen.

fields.label: Social
fields.name: brg_header_pin_social
fields.instructions: Same choice for the social icons.

fields.label: Wordmark
fields.name: brg_header_pin_wordmark
fields.instructions: Same choice for the wordmark at the foot of the menu.

fields.label: Pages
fields.name: brg_header_order_pages
fields.instructions: Where this block sits within its group.

fields.label: Social
fields.name: brg_header_order_social
fields.instructions: Where this block sits within its group.

fields.label: Wordmark
fields.name: brg_header_order_wordmark
fields.instructions: Where this block sits within its group.

fields.label: Page link size
fields.name: brg_header_tm_link_size
fields.instructions: The big menu words, in pixels.

fields.label: Space between blocks
fields.name: brg_header_tm_gap
fields.instructions: The gap between the pages, the social row and the wordmark.

fields.label: Wordmark size
fields.name: brg_header_tm_wordmark_size
fields.instructions: How wide the wordmark is at the foot of the menu.

fields.label: Small label size
fields.name: brg_header_tm_label_size
fields.instructions: The size of the “Menu” and “Follow” labels.

fields.label: Pages
fields.name: brg_header_show_pages
fields.instructions: The page links. Hiding these leaves a menu with only the social row and wordmark.

fields.label: Social
fields.name: brg_header_show_social
fields.instructions: The social icons. They come from the menu assigned to BRG — Social under Appearance → Menus; hiding them here leaves that menu alone.

fields.label: Wordmark
fields.name: brg_header_show_wordmark
fields.instructions: The wordmark at the foot of the menu.

fields.label: “Menu” label
fields.name: brg_header_show_menu_label
fields.instructions: The small label above the page links.

fields.label: “Follow” label
fields.name: brg_header_show_social_label
fields.instructions: The small label above the social icons.

fields.label: Numbers (01, 02…)
fields.name: brg_header_show_numbers
fields.instructions: The running numbers beside each page link.

fields.label: Where the number sits
fields.name: brg_header_num_pos
fields.instructions: The running number beside each page link in the phone menu. Above puts it on its own line over the word, which is how it reads today. Beside puts it on the same line, to the left of the word, which is tighter and lets more of the menu fit on one screen.

fields.label: Line it up with
fields.name: brg_header_num_align
fields.instructions:
Only applies when the number sits beside the word. Top lines the number up with the top of the letters, bottom sits it on the same line the letters stand on, and middle centres it against the word.

Bottom uses the letters' own baseline rather than the bottom of their box, because the box includes the space descenders need and the number would look like it had slipped.

fields.label: Number color
fields.name: brg_header_num_color
fields.instructions: The color of the numbers. Left empty they are the brand yellow, which is the design. Anything set here applies to every number in the phone menu.

fields.label: “Menu” label text
fields.name: brg_header_menu_label
fields.instructions: The wording of the small label above the page links.

fields.label: “Follow” label text
fields.name: brg_header_social_label
fields.instructions: The wording of the small label above the social icons.

fields.label: Wordmark
fields.name: brg_header_wordmark
fields.instructions: The mark at the foot of the phone menu. Leave empty and the menu ends with the social row.

fields.label: Line under the wordmark
fields.name: brg_header_wordmark_line
fields.instructions: A short line beneath it, like a strapline. Leave empty for none.

fields.label: Footer logo
fields.name: brg_footer_logo
fields.instructions: The lockup across the foot of every page. It is artwork, not type — the words behind it exist only as the name a screen reader reads out.

fields.label: Footer logo width
fields.name: brg_footer_logo_width
fields.instructions: How wide the footer logo is, in pixels. 120 to 960 — the stylesheet also wraps it in "or 62% of the screen, whichever is smaller", so a big number still cannot overflow a phone. The logo keeps its own proportions, so any shape of logo works and the height follows the width.

fields.label: Footer logo links to
fields.name: brg_footer_logo_href
fields.instructions: Where clicking it goes. Leave empty and it is not a link at all.

fields.label: Space above
fields.name: brg_footer_pad_top
fields.instructions: The breathing room between the last section and the footer, in pixels.

fields.label: Space below
fields.name: brg_footer_pad_bottom
fields.instructions: The room under the lockup before the page ends.

fields.label: Alignment
fields.name: brg_footer_align
fields.instructions: Where the lockup and the social icon sit.

fields.label: Social icon
fields.name: brg_footer_show_social
fields.instructions: The small icon at the foot. It uses the links saved on Brand info, so hiding it here leaves those alone.

fields.label: Social icon size
fields.name: brg_footer_social_size
fields.instructions: How big that icon is, in pixels.

fields.label: Small print
fields.name: brg_footer_legal
fields.instructions: The copyright line at the foot of every page. Type {year} anywhere in it and the current year is filled in automatically — you never have to come back in January. Leave empty for no small print at all.
fields.default_value: © {year} Blacktop Restaurant Group. All rights reserved.

fields.label: Small print sits
fields.name: brg_footer_legal_align
fields.instructions: Which corner the copyright line and the legal links sit in, independently of how the rest of the footer is aligned.

fields.label: Legal links
fields.name: brg_footer_links
fields.instructions:
ONE LINK PER LINE, written as the words you want, then a vertical bar, then the page path. For example:

Privacy Policy|/privacy-policy/
Cookie Policy|/cookie-policy/

You can also just paste a path on its own — /privacy-policy/ — and the words are made from it. A full web address works too, for anything off this site.

fields.label: Buttons — the default for every button
Size
fields.name: brg_buttons_size
fields.instructions: How big a button is unless something nearer overrules it. Large is what every button has been until now. The three levels are this, then a section's own, then a single button's own row.

fields.label: Filled, outline or text
fields.name: brg_buttons_style
fields.instructions: Filled is a solid block of color. Outline draws the color as a ring with the words in it and nothing behind. Text only drops the box entirely and leaves the words, which reads as a link — pair it with the Underline hover.

fields.label: Hover effect
fields.name: brg_buttons_btn_effect
fields.instructions:
What EVERY button on the site does when someone points at it, unless something nearer overrules it. There are three levels and the nearest one wins: this, then a section's own Hover effect, then a single button's own on its row in the list. Set it here once and only change the exceptions.

Lift is what every button has always done — it rises slightly and casts a shadow. Lift and swap color does that AND flips to the opposite ink; it is the loudest of the set, best kept for one main action. Underline draws a rule under the words and leaves the button still, which reads as a link. Grow swells it in place. Press down pushes it into the page. Fill in floods an outline button with its color, so pair it with Outline. None holds it still.

This is the HOVER only. Anyone who has switched off animation on their device sees no hover movement whatever is chosen here.

fields.label: Hover color
fields.name: brg_buttons_btn_hover
fields.instructions: The color EVERY button changes to when someone points at it, unless something nearer overrules it: this, then a section's own, then a single button's own. "As designed" leaves each button to its own color, and an effect like Fill in swaps to the opposite ink so it still shows something.

fields.label: Color
fields.name: brg_buttons_light_bg
fields.instructions: The light button's background. Every button set to Light on any page uses this, so changing it here changes them all at once.

fields.label: Text on it
fields.name: brg_buttons_light_fg
fields.instructions: The words on that background. Pick something that stays readable against it.

fields.label: Hover color
fields.name: brg_buttons_light_hover_bg
fields.instructions: What the background becomes while someone is pointing at it. Leave it the same as the color above for no change on hover.

fields.label: Text on hover
fields.name: brg_buttons_light_hover_fg
fields.instructions: The words while hovering.

fields.name: brg_buttons_dark_bg
fields.instructions: The dark button's background. Every button set to Dark on any page uses this, so changing it here changes them all at once.

fields.instructions: What the background becomes while someone is pointing at it. Leave it the same as the color above for no change on hover.

fields.label: Text on hover
fields.name: brg_buttons_dark_hover_fg

fields.instructions: The accent button's background. Every button set to Accent on any page uses this, so changing it here changes them all at once.

fields.label: Text on it
fields.name: brg_buttons_accent_fg
fields.instructions: The words on that background. Pick something that stays readable against it.

fields.label: Hover color
fields.name: brg_buttons_accent_hover_bg
fields.instructions: What the background becomes while someone is pointing at it. Leave it the same as the color above for no change on hover.

fields.label: Text on hover
fields.name: brg_buttons_accent_hover_fg
fields.instructions: The words while hovering.

fields.label: Color
fields.name: brg_buttons_alt_bg
fields.instructions: The alt accent button's background. Every button set to Alt accent on any page uses this, so changing it here changes them all at once.

fields.label: Text on it
fields.name: brg_buttons_alt_fg
fields.instructions: The words on that background. Pick something that stays readable against it.

fields.instructions: What the background becomes while someone is pointing at it. Leave it the same as the color above for no change on hover.
